title: Multiplication of Walsh characters
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $\beta,\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The pointwise product of the Walsh characters indexed by $\beta$ and $\gamma$ is the Walsh character indexed by $\beta+\gamma$.
